d:
BJP responds to the INDIA bloc’s Ramlila Maidan rally with a nationwide ‘Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao’ campaign. BJP chief Nitin Nabin led a counter-march in Rohtak, while party leaders held similar protests across Delhi, Mumbai and other cities. BJP also questioned the turnout at the Opposition rally, with Sambit Patra sharing visuals of the venue.
